deploy.startCommand: sh -c "if [ \"${APP_MODE:-bot}\" = api ]; then exec uvicorn api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}; elif [ \"${APP_MODE:-bot}\" = collector ]; then exec python collector_financials.py; elif [ \"${APP_MODE:-bot}\" = quotes ]; then exec python collector_financials.py --trades-only; elif [ \"${APP_MODE:-bot}\" = reports-watch ]; then exec python collector_financials.py --watch-filings; elif [ \"${APP_MODE:-bot}\" = news-collector ]; then exec python news_collector.py; else exec python bot.py; fi"
